policy.processors: **Razorpay** (online payments and refunds), our **courier partners** (delivery), **Resend** (order and support e-mails), **Supabase** (database and image storage, Mumbai region) and **Vercel** (website hosting).
policy.materials_note: charms are made from zinc alloy or stainless steel with enamel, resin or acrylic details. 3D stickers are layered vinyl with a clear domed resin top. DIY kits use glass, acrylic and polymer-clay beads with stainless-steel rings and findings. Keep pieces away from water, perfume and harsh cleaners so the finish lasts.
policy.handmade_note: Many pieces are finished by hand, so small differences in colour, shape and finish from the photos are normal and are not defects.
policy.rto_handling: we contact you by e-mail. For a prepaid order you can ask us to send it again (you pay the shipping again) or take a refund of the order value minus the original shipping fee. A cash-on-delivery order is cancelled, and nothing is charged.
policy.return_conditions:
- The item is unused and in its original packaging, with all parts and tags.
- You ask for the return from the Help page within the return window, with your order reference.
- We check the item when it reaches us and start the refund once it passes the check.
policy.non_returnable_items:
- Opened DIY kits and loose beads
- 3D stickers that have been peeled off their backing
- Items marked final sale
policy.return_shipping_rule: for a change-of-mind return you send the parcel back to us with a tracked courier and pay the return shipping. For a damaged, defective or wrong item we arrange the pickup at no cost to you.
policy.shipping_fee_refund_rule: refunded in full when the whole order is cancelled before dispatch, or when an item arrives damaged, defective or wrong. They are not refunded on other partial refunds.
policy.retention_order_records: 8 years from the end of the financial year in which the order was placed, so we can answer questions about an order and handle any dispute
policy.retention_period: for as long as your account is open, and deleted within 30 days after you delete your account (support messages and photos are deleted 1 year after the case is closed)
